```yaml
name: CI & Release

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  push:
    tags:
      - '*'

jobs:
  ci:
    name: CI
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          override: true
          components: rustfmt, clippy

      - name: Format check
        run: cargo fmt --all -- --check

      - name: Clippy lint
        run: cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings

      - name: Run tests
        run: cargo test --all-features

      - name: Install cargo-audit
        run: cargo install cargo-audit

      - name: Security audit
        run: cargo audit --deny warnings

  release:
    name: Release
    if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/')
    needs: ci
    environment: crates.io
    strategy:
      matrix:
        include:
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            target: x86_64-unknown-linux-musl
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            target: aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
          - os: macos-latest
            target: x86_64-apple-darwin
          - os: macos-latest
            target: aarch64-apple-darwin
          - os: windows-latest
            target: x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
      packages: write
    env:
      CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          override: true
          target: ${{ matrix.target }}

      - name: Install cross (Linux musl & aarch64)
        if: matrix.target == 'x86_64-unknown-linux-musl' || matrix.target == 'aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu'
        run: cargo install cross

      - name: Build
        run: |
          if [[ "${{ matrix.target }}" == *"musl"* || "${{ matrix.target }}" == *"aarch64"* ]]; then
            cross build --release --target ${{ matrix.target }}
          else
            cargo build --release --target ${{ matrix.target }}
          fi

      - name: Package
        run: |
          BIN=keifu
          TARGET=${{ matrix.target }}
          OUT_DIR=target/${TARGET}/release
          if [[ "$TARGET" == *"windows"* ]]; then
            zip -j ${BIN}-${TARGET}.zip ${OUT_DIR}/${BIN}.exe
          else
            tar -czf ${BIN}-${TARGET}.tar.gz -C ${OUT_DIR} ${BIN}
          fi

      - name: Upload artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: ${{ matrix.target }}
          path: |
            keifu-${{ matrix.target }}.tar.gz
            keifu-${{ matrix.target }}.zip

      - name: Generate changelog
        uses: orhun/git-cliff-action@v2
        with:
          args: --output CHANGELOG.md

      - name: Publish to crates.io
        run: cargo publish --locked
```
